status: declared engineering adaptation; freeze by manifest before real data
fidelity: independent 10-second adaptation; exact paper implementation unverified

emd.failure: Reject capped/invalid output; preserve failure and continue other declared pilot tasks. No automatic larger cap or patient replacement.

analytic.implementation: scipy.signal.hilbert native length, no additional extension
analytic.frequency: unwrap phase; numpy.gradient dt=1/fs edge_order=2; signed Hz without clipping
analytic.component_means: frequency mean over valid samples; envelope mean over all retained samples
analytic.global_frequency: instantaneous energy-weighted frequency over valid components, then time mean
analytic.global_envelope: instantaneous root-sum-square of all component envelopes, then time mean
analytic.geometry: sum of four trimmed analytic signals; exact continuous arc-length centroid of open piecewise-linear path; zero-length edges zero weight

pilot.selection: SHA256 id|patient_id; one SHA256 id|record_id-ranked ECG each; fit only, outcomes unused
stages: All 384 baseline leads; independent failures do not stop assessment
Exact repeats of successful Lead-I baselines
All 224 Lead-I perturbations, including records with failed baselines; compare only when both succeed
pilot.relative_difference: 2*abs(a-b)/(abs(a)+abs(b)+1e-12); first ten features only; descriptive warnings, not filtering
pilot.centroid_warning: Euclidean shift divided by baseline global envelope exceeds 0.1
pilot.full_run_gate: synthetic checks pass, every baseline lead succeeds, exact repeat extraction; perturbation failures or warnings are reported and reviewed, never used to remove records
pilot.memory: process ru_maxrss high-water KiB per task, not incremental allocation

amendment.scientific_change: Iteration ceiling 16000 to 64000; all convergence and descriptor criteria unchanged; same selected patients
amendment.evidence: results/eyeball_stopping_diagnostic_v1/summary.json: record 15689 third IMF converged after 46081 sifts with exact uninstrumented parity; FIXE_H=5 diagnostic failed and is not adopted
amendment.execution_change: Collect all predeclared outcomes rather than aborting on first numerical failure; deterministic parallel tasks and explicit artifact reuse
amendment.result_status: No model scoring used; no further ceiling increase is scheduled

execution.restart: Verify and reuse terminal successes and numerical failures; rerun only unfinished tasks
execution.reuse: Import nine verified uncapped 16k Lead-I outputs and the verified default-64k diagnostic for record 15689; check input identity, environment and unchanged numerical settings
execution.completion: Assessment completion is separate from passing the engineering gate. Any baseline failure prevents full extraction and model fitting.
